literal: Proper conduct ignorance it possesses indeed, wealth having given, body ignorance acquiring.
translation: Spending wealth to acquire a state of bodily unawareness is an act of utter senselessness.
modern: பணத்தைக் கொடுத்துத் தன் உடலையே அறியாத மயக்க நிலையை விலைக்கு வாங்குவது, என்ன செய்வதென்று அறியாத பெரும் முட்டாள்தனமாகும்.
explanation: This couplet points out the absurdity of paying for one's own intoxication. The phrase 'பொருள் கொடுத்து' means spending valuable wealth, while 'மெய்யறியாமை கொளல்' refers to buying a drunken state where one loses awareness of their own physical body. The poet concludes that doing this shows a complete lack of basic sense or proper conduct, expressed by the word 'கை' which here signifies proper action or what one ought to do.
